name: genbi
title_zh: 一份语义层，变成能点开即用的网页应用
tagline_zh: 不用碰前端，不用配服务器，一条命令把 Wren 项目的 context layer 变成浏览器里能用的 GenBI…
tagline_en: No frontend work, no server setup. One command turns your Wren context layer into a browser-based GenBI app, then.
desc_en: Turn a Wren project's context layer into a shareable, browser-side GenBI web app and deploy it to the user's Vercel or Cloudflare account. Orchestrates the full flow: `wren genbi build` returns a project-hydrated build instruction, the agent authors the app from scratch into apps/<name>/, then register → verify → deploy produce a shareable URL. Use this skill whenever the user wants to: build a da
why_zh: 它不只是生成静态文件，而是让 agent 根据项目语义层从零写应用，再自动完成注册、验证、部署。
why_en: It doesn't just output static files—the agent authors the app from scratch based on your semantic layer, then handles register.
limit_zh: 只认 Wren 项目且本机已装 Wren CLI；只部署到 Vercel/Cloudflare，不支持其他平台。
limit_en: Requires a Wren project and Wren CLI installed; deploys only to Vercel/Cloudflare; output is a client-side app with no backend; fails if context.
title_en: A semantic layer that becomes a click-to-use web app
